names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 10 decembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Evgraf», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 10 Δεκεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Μηνάς ο Καλλικέλαδος, Ερμογένης και Εύγραφος», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 10. децембар ст. ст., „Свети мученици Мина, Ермоген и Евграф.“ — with «Свети мученици» left off and the last of the three bare forenames taken; the heading gives the three nothing but their names. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured the folded string at 0 other holders.
Read from the calendar’s own name page, «Евграф Александрийский, мч.», with the rank stripped; the day line itself declines it as «Евграфа». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Мчч. Мины, Ермогена и Евграфа (ок. 313).»

attestations.note: The third of the three the day’s first line names, on the same menologion day the Romanian calendar keeps them on. The reading at /Life/life3095.htm gives him an office the folder did not have — «секретаря святого Мины», the secretary of the first of the three — and has the emperor cut him down with his own hand; NO `dates` ARE WRITTEN, the line giving a bounded guess «(ок. 313)» and the reading a reign, and the folder having carried no date through two earlier calendars. THE OFFICE IS NOT WRITTEN EITHER: `tests/i18n.test.mjs` wants every `office` string in all four locale packs, and `Secretary` is not in them. A SECOND EUGRAPHUS STANDS ON THIS SAME DAY and they are two men sixteen centuries apart: this one of about 313, and `eugraphus-pletnev`, a priest of 1918 named in the day’s seventh line with his son. The day page’s three hymns for the company are added to all three folders of 313 and to neither folder of 1918; both kontakia name this man.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 10 decembrie — «Sfântul Mucenic Evgraf»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 10ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Μηνάς ο Καλλικέλαδος, Ερμογένης και Εύγραφος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 10 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the secretary of Menas who was made a Christian by his answer and beheaded with the other two. **The page will not settle the reign** — Maximinus, 311 to 313, or, it allows, Maximian, 286 to 305 — so no `dates` object is proposed. Its relics block stands under his heading — the incorrupt tongue at the monastery of Leimonos on Lesbos, and portions at Docheiariou on Athos and at the Benaki Museum in Athens — but it says «του Αγίου», of the saint, without naming which of the three, so it is recorded here and not drafted. Of the four hymns only the first apolytikion speaks of the three in the plural and is their common; it is copied here, and the two that address Menas by name are taken in his folder only. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 23.12.2025 (10. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Мина, Ермоген и Евграф.“

attestations.note: The third name of the day’s enumerated three; the heading is quoted whole on each of the three folders; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: «мученици» is the `martyr` held, and «тајник», a secretary, is a post and no rank in BRIEF-SERBIAN §5’s table. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT: the emperor Максимин is named with no years. NO `locations`. NO `related` ROW ADDED: `menas-the-athenian` and `hermogenes-of-alexandria` are already `related` here both ways. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: that he was the secretary and friend of Saint Menas, that he was not on trial at all but came forward of his own accord before the tribunal when he saw how bravely the two bore their torments, that he shouted in the emperor’s face «И ја сам хришћанин!», I too am a Christian, and that the emperor in a rage drew his own sword and cut him down — before any executioner, and before the other two were beheaded. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Cu înfrânarea omorând pornirile și îndemnurile cele arzătoare ale patimilor, ucenicii lui Hristos au luat harul de a alunga urmările bolilor celor neputincioși și a face minuni, atât în viață, cât și după moarte. Minune uimitoare cu adevărat! Că oase goale izvorăsc tămăduiri. Slavă Ție, Singurului Dumnezeu și Ziditorului.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Mina, Ermoghen și Evgraf (one hymn printed for the three together; the page prints no glas)

english.text: Having put to death by abstinence the burning stirrings and promptings of the passions, the disciples of Christ received the grace to drive away the effects of the sicknesses of the infirm and to work wonders, both in life and after death. A marvel indeed: that bare bones pour out healings. Glory to you, the only God and Maker.

hymns.text: Δι' ἐγκρατείας, τῶν παθῶν τὰς πυριφλέκτους, ἀπονεκρώσαντες ὁρμὰς καὶ τὰς κινήσεις, τοῦ Χριστοῦ οἱ Μάρτυρες ἔλαβον τὴν χάριν, τὰς νόσους ἀποδιώκειν τῶν ἀσθενῶν, καὶ ζῶντες καὶ μετὰ τέλος θαυματουργεῖν· ὄντως θαῦμα παράδοξον! ὅτι ὀστέα γυμνά, ἐκβλύζουσιν ἰάματα. Δόξα τῷ μόνῳ Θεῷ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Τὸ προσταχθὲν — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Μηνάς ο Καλλικέλαδος, Ερμογένης και Εύγραφος»; it is the common of the three martyrs, in the plural, printed as their service.

english.text: Having put to death by abstinence the fire-burning rushes and motions of the passions, the martyrs of Christ received the grace to drive away the diseases of the sick and to work wonders both while they lived and after their end. Truly a strange wonder, that bare bones should pour out healings! Glory to our only God.

hymns.text: Воздержанием страстей огнепальныя/ умертвивше зраки и движения, Христовы мученицы/ прияша благодать недуги отгоняти немощных/ и живше и по кончине чудодействовати./ Воистинну чудо преславно,/ яко кости наги источают исцеления,// слава Единому и Создателю Богу.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст., «Тропарь мучеников», глас 8 — a common of martyrs, printed under no one name, and the only company the day heads is this one of three

english.text: By abstinence the martyrs of Christ put to death the fiery looks and motions of the passions, and received grace to drive sickness from the weak and to work wonders both in their life and after their end. Truly a marvellous wonder, that bare bones should pour forth healings: glory to the one God and Creator.

hymns.text: Добропесненный глас твоих словес,/ Ермогена из глубины погибели возвед,/ постави на камени жизни,/ отонудуже и Евграф, царя обличив,/ радуяся, посекается в славную главу,/ но прилежно моли, Мино,// спастися всем, любовию чтущим тя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст., «Кондак мучеников», глас 4 — addressed to Menas and naming the other two of his company, of whom he is the second

english.text: The sweet-singing voice of thy words led Hermogenes up out of the depth of perdition and set him upon the rock of life; whence Eugraphus also, rebuking the emperor, was gladly struck down upon his glorious head. But pray earnestly, O Menas, that all who honour thee with love may be saved.

hymns.text: Мину чуднаго, Ермогена Божественнаго и Евграфа купно/ священными сладкопении почтим вси,/ яко почествовавшия Господа,/ и страдальчествовавшия за Него,/ и лика Безплотных на Небесех достигшия,// и чудеса точащия.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст., «Кондак мучеников», глас 1 — the second kontakion the page prints for the company, naming all three men

english.text: Let us all together honour with sacred sweet songs the wondrous Menas, the divine Hermogenes and Eugraphus, for they gave honour to the Lord and suffered for his sake, and have attained to the choir of the bodiless powers in the heavens, and pour forth wonders.
